# Fixture Business Licence Guide

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Who needs a licence

Every shop, market stall and food truck in Fixture City needs a business licence before it opens.

## 2 Licence fee

The business licence fee is 120 euros per year. Market stalls pay a reduced fee of 60 euros.

## 3 Processing

Business licence applications are processed within 15 working days. Applicants submit Form BL-310 at the Licensing Desk.
